learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to train your artist eyes to observe everyday non-moving objects and turn them into amazing drawings!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A 'Still Life' is a drawing of non-moving objects like fruits, books, or flower vases. Because these everyday things stay completely still, they give you all the time you need to practice your drawing skills!

Every tricky object is just a bunch of simple shapes hiding inside! A cup is like a cylinder, an orange is a circle, and a book is a rectangle. Spotting these basic shapes first makes drawing anything super easy.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🔦 The Magic of Light and Shadow
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Notice where the light hits an object and where the dark shadow hides. Adding shading to these dark spots is like magic because it makes your flat drawing look like a real, 3D object that pops off the page!
Composition simply means how you arrange your objects together on the table before you draw. Grouping a tall bottle next to a small round apple creates a fun, balanced, and interesting picture.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Kitchen Table Masterpiece
fun_activity.instructions: Grab an apple and a favorite mug from your kitchen and place them near a sunny window. Look at how the sunlight creates cool shadows, break the objects into basic shapes, and sketch your very first still life!

quick_recap: ⭐ Still life art features everyday objects that do not move.
⭐ You can draw anything by breaking it down into simple shapes like circles and rectangles first.
⭐ Shading adds magic to your artwork and makes flat drawings look 3D.
⭐ How you arrange your objects makes your final drawing look more interesting.
